source.title: WRC Leader Announcement (June 2024)
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Committee Leader. Carter Kucala is the new Leader of the WCA Regulations Committee (WRC). Carter was already working as a senior member of the WRC.

Carter was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote among the current Committee Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our [Motion](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) about WCA Committees and Teams.


We would like to thank Antonio Kam for the work he has done in leading the WRC for the past 2 years. We wish Carter all the best in this new role.


Carter was among three applicants we had and all the candidacy documents can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1296uv-Xm6QQJALXsoKrvAamh53UCVaJv) if you are interested in viewing them. 

Other candidates who applied:
- Hao Chang
- Ekaterina Kaneva

translation.title: WCA 规则委员会负责人任命公告（2024 年 6 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴宣布，Carter Kucala 出任 WCA 规则委员会（WRC）负责人。Carter 此前已是 WRC 资深成员。

根据关于 WCA 委员会与团队的[决议](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 4 节，WCA 董事会选定 Carter，并经现任委员会负责人及高级代表投票通过。

感谢 Antonio Kam 在过去两年带领 WRC 所做的工作。祝 Carter 在新岗位上一切顺利。

本次共收到三份申请，Carter 是其中一位申请人。全部申请材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1296uv-Xm6QQJALXsoKrvAamh53UCVaJv)查看。

另外两位申请人是：
- Hao Chang
- Ekaterina Kaneva
